q1: SELECT FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(FOLLOWEE) AS NUM FROM FOLLOW WHERE FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
q2: SELECT F.FOLLOWEE AS FOLLOWER, COUNT(DISTINCT F.FOLLOWER) NUM FROM FOLLOW F WHERE F.FOLLOWEE IN (SELECT FOLLOWER FROM FOLLOW) AND F.FOLLOWEE != F.FOLLOWER GROUP BY F.FOLLOWEE ORDER BY F.FOLLOWEE
